ai_disclosure: AI was used to read the regulation text into rule candidates. Values labeled 'Derived' come from readings that passed review; values labeled 'Interpretation' come from readings not yet reviewed, or depend on a condition the engine does not model. In this demo the review was first an AI review applied on the project owner's instruction; the project owner then approved most of the rules the engine reads, in bulk from a review sheet, and the rest rest on the AI review alone. Each value's source panel says which. No AI model is used to compute this assessment.
disclaimers: Decision support for licensed professionals, not a zoning determination. Confirm every result with the jurisdiction before relying on it: LA City Planning and LADBS in the City, LA County Regional Planning and Public Works in unincorporated areas.

items.explanation: An ADU of up to 1,200 sq ft (22.140.640 G.1.a) and up to 25 ft tall, attached or detached (G.1.b), at least 4 ft from the rear, interior side and corner side lot lines (G.1.c). On a single-family lot the County allows one ADU attached to or within the home or an accessory building, one detached ADU and one JADU (Table 22.140.640-A). A Community Standards District may set a lower height, but not below 16 ft for a detached ADU. No parking is required outside a Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone (G.1.d.i). From the County's ADU ordinance (Ord. 2025-0029, adopted 2025-07-29). In December 2025 the state housing department (HCD) found parts of it out of line with state ADU law: it leaves out units state law allows, and its height limits inside Community Standards Districts leave out the 25 ft state law allows for an attached ADU. The County planned to amend it. Where state law allows more, state law applies.

Local standards may not prevent two units of at least 800 sq ft each, and side and rear setbacks may be at most 4 ft (none for an existing structure rebuilt in place) (65852.21(b)). Checked: the lot is in a single-family zone (R-1); no historic preservation overlay (HPOZ) is mapped here. The loaded maps show no Very High fire hazard zone, earthquake fault zone or 100-year flood plain here (Gov. Code 65913.4(a)(6)(D), (F) and (G)). Still to confirm: no demolition or alteration of rent-restricted or rent-controlled housing, or housing a tenant occupied in the last 3 years; no units withdrawn from rent under the Ellis Act in the last 15 years; the Gov. Code 65913.4(a)(6) sites not mapped here: farmland (B), wetlands (C), listed hazardous waste sites (E), a regulatory floodway (H), natural community conservation plan lands (I), protected species habitat (J) and conservation easements (K). SB 9 uses that section as it read on 2021-09-16; the copy loaded here is the 2026 text, whose (B)-(K) list the same kinds of site; that the lot is not an individually listed historic resource or a City or County landmark.

items.explanation: This lot is in the South Bay Planning Area Standards District (Chapter 22.318, adopted 2025-03-11), whose standards apply with the zone's and govern where they differ. For homes it adds: fences and walls within 10 ft of the front property line at most 5.5 ft tall, with no more than 42 inches solid and half the part above that open, and at most 6 ft elsewhere in the front yard (22.318.060 F.1.b); drought-tolerant front-yard planting (F.1.a); rooftop equipment, elevator shafts and stairwells left out of the height limit (22.318.060 C); and shielded outdoor lighting and screened mechanical equipment (22.318.070 C.1). The Del Aire and Wiseburn community standards districts prohibit accessory commercial units (22.318.090, 22.318.150). It sets no yards or height for Zone R-1, and it does not limit ADU floor area or height (22.140.640 G.1.a). Not checked against a project here.

summary.answer: A single-family home up to 35 ft high, with yards of 20 ft front, 5 ft each side and 15 ft rear. Plus one ADU (detached, 800 sq ft that the County must approve or up to 1,200 under the County ordinance) and one JADU of up to 500 sq ft inside the home (Gov. Code 66323). SB 9 may also allow two homes or a lot split, to confirm.
